metadata.name: Talents for Everyone
metadata.description:
[h1]Talents for Everyone[/h1] An add-on for [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3305869734]Passive Skill Trees[/url]: real character trees for modded characters, and more interesting talents for every vanilla one — not just "+1% to a stat".
[h2]Own trees for modded characters (41 trees)[/h2] Each is a full tree of about 110 nodes with five branches built around the character's own mechanics: [list] [*][b]Fiend Folio[/b] — Fiend, Golem, Inaba, Friend, Slippy, China, Craig, Fend, Frond, Fient, Mi, Freezer Jr., Peat, Classic Fiend, Image, The Skeletal Fiend and tainted Fiend, Golem, Friend, Inaba. [*][b]Furtherance[/b] — Leah, Peter, Miriam and their tainted versions. [*][b]Lost and Forgotten[/b] — Robot, Joseph and their tainted versions. [*][b]IPECAC[/b] — Moses and Tainted Moses. [*][b]Epiphany[/b] — the tarnished Isaac, Magdalene, Cain, Judas, ???, Samson, Eden, Lost and Keeper. [/list] Without this mod those characters only get the shared tree.
[h2]New talents for vanilla characters[/h2] [list] [*]+20 nodes in the tree of every vanilla and tainted character (34 trees), with mechanics from the character: Azazel's Scapegoat, Bethany's wisps that flare up, ???'s stench cloud, Apollyon's void, and so on. [*]+53 nodes in the global tree: hunting, luck, endurance, exploring, tempo. [/list] Every talent has a hand-drawn icon and a description in English and Russian (follows the game language).
[h2]Requirements[/h2] [list] [*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3127536138]REPENTOGON[/url] [*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3305869734]Passive Skill Trees (Rep+)[/url] [*]for modded trees — the mod of that character (Fiend Folio, Furtherance, Lost and Forgotten, IPECAC, Epiphany); a tree appears only if its character is installed [/list]
[h2]Links[/h2] Source code: [url=https://github.com/blackhellvelz-prog/isaac-talents-for-everyone]GitHub[/url] More from the same set: Basement Scrapbook Menu, Dead Sea Scrolls: Unrolled, Peat, Isaac-Style, Mod Fixes & Speedups, Russian Translation for Mods.
Made with Universal Modder. Passive Skill Trees is made by its author; this mod adds trees through its API and does not change its files. Author: blackhellvelz.
